answer_text: the deletion of a node depends upon if it has children and if it is an AVL binary search tree. Assuming it is not an AVL tree, and the node being deleted has no children, you just set its pointer to null. If it has a left child or a right child exclusively, that child replaces the deleted node, if it has two children, the left most child of the right sub tree (or right most child of the left subtree)will replace it
